investigation: PSI-106, SLICE: laminar coflow jet diffusion flames in the Microgravity Science Glovebox, stepped up line by line to blow-off
description: Second law of PROTOCOL 13.4 (docs/wsp/research/phys_slice2.md): the eight features of slice; the log's lifted label is scored as p_lift_noted * (p_past_lift - p_past_blow) / (1 - p_past_blow), a scoring-time rule.

features.name: x_fuel
features.description: hydrocarbon mole fraction of the jet gas

features.name: mdot_jet
features.description: jet gas mass flow (mdot_jet_mg_s / 1e6); read by flame_length only

targets.name: past_lift
targets.description: the condition is past the lifting limit (the network W0 called lifted)

targets.name: past_blow
targets.description: the condition is past the blow-off limit, cumulative

targets.name: lift_noted
targets.description: a lifted flame is written down as lifted; no feature dependence
